Each SupportTicket uses exactly one HelpDeskService, and each HelpDeskService serves zero or more SupportTicket records. Each HelpDeskService manages one or more Resolution records by composition, and each Resolution belongs to exactly one HelpDeskService. Each Requester can reference zero or more Resolution records, and each Resolution can be referenced by zero or more Requester records.
